validation.notes: Repaired three linked production faults on the project-trust boundary and validated them end to end with the real modules. resource-loader.ts loadProjectTrustExtensions() now forces setProjectTrusted(false) for the bootstrap pass, so pre-consent package resolution and extension loading see only global and temporary CLI resources. settings-manager.ts loadFromStorage() now skips the project scope when the manager is untrusted (scope === 'project' && !projectTrusted), restoring the trust argument that was previously ignored on construction, setProjectTrusted(false) and reload(). project-trust.ts resolveProjectTrusted() now checks options.trustOverride !== undefined, so an explicit false override wins without invoking extensions, prompting or writing consent. Public APIs, call sites, global/CLI resource behaviour and nested deepMergeSettings inheritance are unchanged. The regression script loads packages/coding-agent/src/core/{settings-manager,resource-loader,project-trust}.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs with only storage IO, package resolution, extension loading and trust UI faked; it asserts bootstrap extension/package resolution is global-only for an already-trusted process, that a trusted reload afterwards admits project.ts with nested project settings merged over inherited global ones (reserveTokens overridden, keepRecentTokens inherited), that explicit false/true overrides short-circuit with no extension-decision event and no consent writes, and that SettingsManager.fromStorage({projectTrusted:false}) ignores project settings and re-reads them only after setProjectTrusted(true)/reload(). Cleanup of .prale-eval/tmp inputs happens in a finally block (verified absent after the run); assertions use node:assert/strict and are driven by promise ordering, with no real time, randomness or external services. Each faulty baseline was restored alone and the script failed with an AssertionError (no crash/import error) for all three files. The repository's vitest suite could not be run because node_modules is not installed and dependency installation is out of scope for this task.
